title: Jurisdiction, venue.
bodyText: An action under section 445-95.5 or 445-95.6 shall be brought in the district court and division in which the rooming house is located.
bodyHtml: [§445-95.7]  Jurisdiction, venue.  An action under section 445-95.5 or 445-95.6 shall be brought in the district court and division in which the rooming house is located. [L 1988, c 313, pt of §3]
